description: User-facing help for every registered action and screen-level focus target.

help.summary: Choose a benchmark task or review prior results.
help.usage: Use the navigation keys to open a screen, then press ? for the actions available there.

help.summary: Materialize or recover the local development channel.
help.usage: Review provenance and warnings before starting; cancel preserves the previous install and retry remains available after rollback.

help.summary: Identifies the ASB setup journey while preserving the current context.
help.usage: Read the header to confirm that choices belong to the setup wizard before changing the focused control.

help.summary: Shows the complete setup and benchmark journey with [x] complete, [>] current, [ ] future, and [-] unavailable markers.
help.usage: Use Tab to focus a shell pane and read the current marker; use Enter or Esc, Left, or an empty Backspace rather than treating the progress labels as step navigation.

help.summary: Shows every wizard choice with a visible focus cursor and unchecked or checked marker.
help.usage: Use Up or Down to move the cursor. Space toggles one agent and A toggles visible agents; Enter selects one compatible provider, model, or preset.

help.summary: Explains the focused choice and any unavailable state without mixing it with current selections.
help.usage: Read this pane to understand the focused row; unavailable rows remain visibly disabled and cannot be selected.

help.summary: Lists selected values in a separate framed pane.
help.usage: Check this pane before continuing. It remains separate from focused-item details so multi-choice selections are unambiguous.

help.summary: Choose which supported agents will execute the benchmark.
help.usage: Use Space to toggle one available agent or A to select or clear the visible available agents; filtering never changes hidden choices.

help.summary: Choose the provider that supplies the selected agent model.
help.usage: Review the provider capabilities and choose one compatible with the selected agent before moving on.

help.summary: Choose the model exposed by the selected provider.
help.usage: Select a model reported by the provider and check its availability before continuing with setup.

help.summary: Choose a supported benchmark-default preset without typing an opaque configuration value.
help.usage: Use Up or Down to review bounded presets, then press Enter; unsupported restored values fail before materialization.

help.summary: Choose a safe credential-reference name without reading or displaying the referenced credential value.
help.usage: Use Up or Down for the conventional OpenRouter environment reference, or the documented fixture keys for warning-only development setup.

help.summary: Shows that workload selection belongs to the benchmark journey but is unavailable until ASB supplies its authoritative catalog.
help.usage: A [-] marker means this standalone setup wizard has not completed the stage; connect the authoritative catalog before selecting workloads.

help.summary: Shows that measure selection belongs to the benchmark journey but is unavailable until ASB supplies its authoritative catalog.
help.usage: A [-] marker means this standalone setup wizard has not completed the stage; connect the authoritative catalog before selecting measures.

help.summary: Create a deterministic local development credential fixture.
help.usage: Press E on Authentication to generate digest-only metadata; this is explicitly development-only and never contacts a provider.

help.summary: Check that the local development fixture is usable.
help.usage: Press T after enrollment; a bounded status changes to tested without exposing a credential or requiring authorization.

help.summary: Generate a fresh generation of the local fixture metadata.
help.usage: Press R after enrollment or testing; the old digest is replaced and the new generation remains development-only.

help.summary: Clear local fixture metadata before starting again.
help.usage: Press X on Authentication to remove digest projections and return to a reset state; no provider secret is touched.

help.summary: Select the local development authentication method.
help.usage: Press F on Authentication to use the warning-labeled fixture instead of an external production helper.

help.summary: Select the provider's explicitly unauthenticated development mode.
help.usage: Press N only for a provider that supports no authentication; the TUI does not claim production authorization.

help.summary: Discard the current fixture attempt and restart its bounded generation.
help.usage: Press Z after cancellation or an interrupted attempt; previous digest metadata is cleared before retrying.

help.summary: Choose an explicit live-provider or local-mock recording mode from the bounded list.
help.usage: Use Up or Down and press Enter; an unknown or stale value is rejected instead of silently selecting local mock.

help.summary: Choose the strict offline replay policy without permitting a live-provider fallback.
help.usage: Review the bounded policy with Up or Down, then press Enter; replay still requires compatible recorded evidence.

help.summary: Review every setup choice before the configuration is completed.
help.usage: Confirm the displayed agent, provider, model, and policies; go back to correct any choice before finishing.

help.summary: Shows that executing a benchmark requires an authoritative ASB plan and launch.
help.usage: The [-] marker is truthful availability information, not a failed local setup choice; finish setup and use ASB to launch an approved plan.

help.summary: Shows that results require completed authoritative benchmark runs.
help.usage: The [-] marker prevents the wizard from implying that results already exist.

help.summary: Shows that comparisons require completed authoritative benchmark runs.
help.usage: The [-] marker prevents the wizard from implying that comparable result data already exists.

help.summary: Navigate catalog and bounded preset choices without free-form input on the supported path.
help.usage: Use Up or Down or j/k to choose, Tab to cycle visible panes, Space to toggle one agent, A to select or clear visible agents, Enter to confirm, Esc, Left, or empty Backspace to go back, and ? to open contextual help.

help.summary: Shows the safe keyboard actions available at the current wizard step.
help.usage: Read the footer before acting; it lists selection, continuation, back, help, and cancellation keys for the visible context.

help.summary: Review and edit the frontend connection and run defaults.
help.usage: Move between settings with the arrow keys and confirm an edited value with Enter.

help.summary: Choose benchmark groups and the individual measures to run.
help.usage: Search or move through the catalog; Space toggles the focused measure and A toggles visible measures.

help.summary: Start a configured benchmark and monitor its progress.
help.usage: Review the selected measures before pressing Enter; Ctrl-C requests cancellation of an active run.

help.summary: Inspect completed and active runs that can feed a report.
help.usage: Refresh the list when new runs finish, then select a run to inspect or compare.

help.summary: Compare selected benchmark runs and inspect their measurements.
help.usage: Select compatible runs in Recent runs, then choose Compare to review differences.

help.summary: Find the action, key binding, or explanation for the current screen.
help.usage: Type to filter the catalog, move through matching entries, and press Esc to return.

help.summary: Close the ASB TUI while leaving the benchmark runner running.
help.usage: Press q from any screen when you have finished using the frontend.

help.summary: Return to the previous screen without changing the runner.
help.usage: Press Esc when the current screen or overlay is no longer needed.

help.summary: Open the landing screen and choose another benchmark task.
help.usage: Press 1 from a workspace screen to return to the frontend starting point.

help.summary: Open the settings used by the frontend before a run.
help.usage: Press 3 from a workspace screen to review connection and benchmark defaults.

help.summary: Open the catalog for choosing benchmark groups and measures.
help.usage: Press 2 before a run to change which measurements will be collected.

help.summary: Open the screen for starting or stopping a benchmark run.
help.usage: Press s after configuration and measure selection are ready.

help.summary: Open the list of recent runs used for inspection and reports.
help.usage: Press r to review available run history.

help.summary: Open report analysis for comparing selected benchmark runs.
help.usage: Press 4 to inspect recent results and select compatible report inputs.

help.summary: Open searchable help for actions and key bindings.
help.usage: Press ? or h for guidance, or press F1 while a text field owns printable keys.

help.summary: Reconnect the frontend to the negotiated ASB control endpoint.
help.usage: Use reconnect after a temporary connection loss, then verify the capability state.

help.summary: Focus the search field for filtering the current help catalog.
help.usage: Press / and type a word such as report or measure to narrow the entries.

help.summary: Select or deselect every measure currently visible in the catalog.
help.usage: Press A after filtering or grouping the catalog to change the whole visible set.

help.summary: Select or deselect the measure currently under the cursor.
help.usage: Move to a measure and press Space; the selection marker shows the resulting state.

help.summary: Search the nested benchmark catalog without changing hidden selections.
help.usage: Press / and type a bounded query matching a pool, group, benchmark, or measure, then move through the visible results.

help.summary: Choose which supported benchmark pool supplies the campaign choices.
help.usage: Press P to move between pools; changing the pool clears incompatible choices and requires an explicit new selection.

help.summary: Select or clear all available measures belonging to the focused benchmark.
help.usage: Press b to review the benchmark-level choice; unavailable measures remain visibly excluded.

help.summary: Start the configured benchmark with the selected measures.
help.usage: Press Enter only after checking the runner, configuration, and measure summary.

help.summary: Ask ASB to stop the benchmark that is currently running.
help.usage: Press Ctrl-C once and wait for the runner to report its terminal state.

help.summary: Admit the selected agents as one bounded fan-out.
help.usage: Press A only after reviewing the selected set; the runner returns exact member identities.

help.summary: Cancel every admitted fan-out member by exact identity.
help.usage: Press Ctrl-Z once and wait for the runner acknowledgement before retrying.

help.summary: Fetch the latest recent-run projections from the ASB endpoint.
help.usage: Press f when a run may have completed or the list appears stale.

help.summary: Compare the selected report runs using matching measurements.
help.usage: Press v after choosing the runs and confirm that their measure sets are compatible.

help.summary: Refresh the runner-owned provider and model catalog.
help.usage: Control v1.15 shows the authenticated OpenRouter roster. Older servers and auth, quota, malformed, oversized, or unavailable refreshes stay typed and never fall back.

help.summary: Build and show the reviewed configuration summary before applying it.
help.usage: Press V on Configuration; the bundle is validated against the current provider and benchmark selections and no file is changed.

help.summary: Persist the reviewed configuration bundle atomically.
help.usage: Press A only after reviewing the digest and selections in Preflight; a configured private store is required and failures retain the pending bundle.

help.summary: Estimate the selected agent and workload recording matrix.
help.usage: Review the bounded tuple estimate before creating a capture plan; estimation does not contact the provider.

help.summary: Create a runner-owned plan for recording selected workloads.
help.usage: Check the provider, model, agents, and workload scope before confirming the plan.

help.summary: Explicitly authorize the planned provider response capture.
help.usage: Confirm only after reviewing the scope; a second confirmation dispatch starts the campaign.

help.summary: Refresh authoritative progress for the recording campaign.
help.usage: Use this while capture is active; the runner remains authoritative for coverage and state.

help.summary: Request cancellation of the active recording campaign.
help.usage: Cancel when capture should stop, then wait for the runner lifecycle response.

help.summary: Reconcile a recording campaign interrupted during capture.
help.usage: Use this only when the runner reports reconciliation is required before continuing.

help.summary: Activate offline defaults after complete recording coverage.
help.usage: This remains disabled until every requested tuple is complete and the runner confirms readiness.

help.summary: Publish immutable cassette metadata after complete recording coverage.
help.usage: Press S only after capture is complete; the runner binds the seal to campaign, generation, provider, agent, and workload identities.

help.summary: Resume a recording interrupted during capture after reconciliation.
help.usage: Press U only when the runner reports an interrupted campaign; terminal or stale campaigns remain unavailable.

help.summary: Remove one explicitly selected development cassette.
help.usage: Press D after reviewing the digest and confirmation; production deletion remains runner-authorized and fail-closed.

help.summary: Retry a failed or interrupted run with bounded idempotency.
help.usage: Press t after selecting one eligible run; the runner rejects stale or terminally incompatible requests without mutation.

help.summary: Compare digest-bound live and offline benchmark evidence.
help.usage: Press C after selecting compatible evidence; provider, model, agent, workload, cassette, and generation identities must match.

help.summary: Filter benchmark measures by group or name.
help.usage: Type a term to narrow the catalog, then move through matching measures and press Space to change selection.

help.summary: Choose whether this benchmark measure will run.
help.usage: Move to a measure and press Space; the selection marker shows whether it is included.

help.summary: Lists selected measures separately from the catalog rows.
help.usage: Review the framed summary before starting a run; press A to select or clear visible measures, or Space for one focused measure.

help.summary: Select or clear the visible measures in this group.
help.usage: Press the group toggle to change only the filtered members without altering hidden selections.

help.summary: Filter nested benchmark pools, groups, benchmarks, and measures.
help.usage: Type a bounded query to narrow visible choices; filtering never changes selections that are hidden.

help.summary: Choose the supported benchmark pool for this campaign.
help.usage: Select one pool before reviewing groups and benchmarks; moving pools clears stale choices rather than guessing.

help.summary: Select or clear visible benchmarks and their available measures.
help.usage: Press g to change only the focused group while preserving choices outside the current search.

help.summary: Include a benchmark and its available measures in the campaign.
help.usage: Press b on a benchmark to select it, then review individual measures before handing the exact campaign to ASB.

help.summary: Edit the setting used by the next benchmark.
help.usage: Press Enter to focus, type a bounded value, use Backspace to correct it, press Enter to commit the valid draft, then Ctrl-S to apply it. Invalid text is retained visibly and never persisted.

help.summary: Find a configuration setting by name or description.
help.usage: Type a bounded query to filter settings while preserving the draft values already entered.

help.summary: Shows the provider, model, agent, and recording readiness reported by ASB.
help.usage: Review this status before applying setup changes or starting a run; unavailable fields remain disabled until the runner responds.

help.summary: Shows the exact digest-bound provider and benchmark configuration that will be applied.
help.usage: Press V on Configuration to review the provider, model, agents, pool, measures, and development-only warning before applying.

help.summary: Shows the current benchmark lifecycle and progress.
help.usage: Read this status before starting, cancelling, reconnecting, or leaving the run-control screen.

help.summary: Start a benchmark with the validated configuration and measures.
help.usage: Press Enter only after the runner, configuration, and selected-measure summary are ready.

help.summary: Request cancellation of the active benchmark run.
help.usage: Press Ctrl-C once, then wait for ASB to report a terminal result before retrying.

help.summary: Select a recent run for inspection or comparison.
help.usage: Move through newest-first history and select a run whose measurements and status you trust.

help.summary: Fetch the latest run history from the ASB endpoint.
help.usage: Press f after a run finishes or when the visible history may be stale.

help.summary: Choose a run to inspect evidence, measures, failures, and provenance.
help.usage: Select a completed run, review its evidence and measure status, then use its recovery guidance before comparing results.

help.summary: Compare selected runs after reviewing evidence and compatibility.
help.usage: Press v after selecting inputs; incompatible provider, model, catalog, configuration, or evidence is never ranked as comparable.

help.summary: Filter contextual help by action, screen, or topic.
help.usage: Press /, type a bounded query, and move through matching entries to find the current guidance.

help.summary: Read the explanation and key binding for this context.
help.usage: Move through entries with the navigation keys and press Esc when you understand the action.

help.summary: Move safely between the available TUI screens.
help.usage: Use the documented keys or Tab, and press Esc to return from an overlay without changing data.

help.summary: Shows whether the frontend has an authenticated ASB connection.
help.usage: Reconnect only after checking the status message; unavailable or stale responses remain disabled.

help.summary: Replay the explicitly selected authenticated cassette offline.
help.usage: Select a cassette from the runner-owned catalog first; no default or live fallback is allowed.

help.summary: Move the explicit offline cassette selection through the runner catalog.
help.usage: Press ] to select a published digest before pressing J to replay; no implicit fallback is used.

help.summary: Open the recoverable development-channel materializer handoff.
help.usage: Press d on Home to review the selected channel, source provenance, and development-only warning.

help.summary: Clone and build a temporary development candidate before activation.
help.usage: Review provenance first; activation is atomic and preserves the previous installation if it fails.

help.summary: Cancel an active temporary clone or build without losing the prior install.
help.usage: Press x while the handoff is active; staged work is cleaned by the materializer.

help.summary: Retry a failed or rolled-back development-channel handoff.
help.usage: Press r after reviewing the bounded error and cleanup state; no credentials or signatures are required in development mode.

help.summary: Shows the legal keys and concise guidance for the currently focused element.
help.usage: Read this footer before acting, then press question mark or h for the complete contextual action list.

help.summary: Groups only the actions that are legal in the current visible context.
help.usage: Use Up or Down to inspect an action, then press Escape, question mark, h, or F1 to restore the previous focus.

help.summary: Explains one currently legal action without exposing unrelated shortcuts.
help.usage: Move with Up or Down and read the selected action usage before closing contextual help.

help.summary: Open the guided setup journey from the landing screen.
help.usage: Press w on Home to configure supported agents, providers, models, and benchmark defaults.

help.summary: Move focus through the visible wizard panes without changing a selection.
help.usage: Press Tab to move to the next visible pane while preserving drafts and current choices.

help.summary: Return to the prior setup step while preserving completed choices.
help.usage: Press Escape or Left to revisit the previous step without cancelling the complete wizard.

help.summary: Return from an empty wizard field to the previous setup step.
help.usage: Press Backspace only when the current editable field is empty to move back safely.

help.summary: Return to the previous wizard step using directional navigation.
help.usage: Press Left to revisit the prior step while retaining already accepted setup choices.

help.summary: Leave the setup wizard without completing its pending configuration.
help.usage: Press q to return to Home; choices not completed by the wizard remain unapplied.

help.summary: Finish the reviewed setup choices and return to the workspace.
help.usage: Press Enter on Review only after checking every displayed selection and warning.

help.summary: Move the cursor through visible authoritative wizard catalog choices.
help.usage: Press Up or Down to inspect another visible agent, provider, or model without selecting it.

elements.label: Move catalog cursor with vi keys

help.summary: Move through visible wizard catalog choices using familiar vi navigation.
help.usage: Press j or k to inspect another visible choice without changing the current selection.

help.summary: Narrow the visible authoritative catalog while retaining hidden selections.
help.usage: Type a bounded search query to find a supported agent, provider, or model.

help.summary: Remove the final character from the current wizard catalog filter.
help.usage: Press Backspace while the query is not empty to broaden the visible catalog results.

help.summary: Choose the focused available item from the authoritative setup catalog.
help.usage: Press Enter on one available provider or model; use Enter or Space for an agent.

help.summary: Select or clear every available agent visible under the current filter.
help.usage: Press A on the Agent step; hidden agents and unavailable rows remain unchanged.

help.summary: Move through the supported bounded choices for the current setup step.
help.usage: Press Up or Down to inspect another configuration, authentication, recording, or replay choice.

elements.label: Move bounded choice with vi keys

help.summary: Move through supported bounded setup choices using vi navigation.
help.usage: Press j or k to inspect another choice without changing the accepted value.

help.summary: Accept the valid current value and advance to the next setup step.
help.usage: Press Enter after reviewing the current bounded choice or completed editable value.

help.summary: Enter a bounded value for the current editable wizard field.
help.usage: Type the intended value and review it before pressing Enter to continue.

help.summary: Remove the final character from the current editable wizard value.
help.usage: Press Backspace while text is present; an empty field uses Backspace to return instead.

help.summary: Open guidance limited to actions legal at the current wizard step.
help.usage: Press question mark to inspect contextual actions without changing focus, drafts, or selections.

help.summary: Open the same contextual wizard guidance through its keyboard alias.
help.usage: Press h to inspect current actions without changing focus, drafts, or selections.

help.summary: Move input focus into or out of the benchmark and measure catalog filter.
help.usage: Press slash to focus the filter, type a bounded query, then press Enter or Escape to return to measure actions.

help.summary: Move through measures that remain visible under the current filter.
help.usage: Press Up or Down to inspect another measure without changing its selection.

help.summary: Add text to the current benchmark and measure catalog filter.
help.usage: Type a bounded query to narrow visible rows while preserving every selection.

help.summary: Remove the final character from the active measure catalog filter.
help.usage: Press Backspace to broaden the visible results without changing selected measures.

help.summary: Select or clear available measures in the currently focused group.
help.usage: Press g to change the focused group while preserving choices outside that group.

help.summary: Move focus between the visible configuration entries without editing them.
help.usage: Press Up or Down to review another setting and its contextual explanation.

help.summary: Begin editing the currently focused configuration value as a draft.
help.usage: Press Enter to focus the value, then type a bounded replacement before committing it.

help.summary: Add text to the active configuration draft without persisting it.
help.usage: Type a bounded value, review it, and press Enter only when it is valid.

help.summary: Remove the final character from the active configuration draft.
help.usage: Press Backspace while editing, then review the corrected value before committing it.

help.summary: Accept the valid current draft into the pending frontend configuration.
help.usage: Press Enter after editing; use Ctrl-S separately to persist the pending configuration.

help.summary: Persist the reviewed pending frontend configuration for later benchmark use.
help.usage: Press Ctrl-S after validating every changed setting and reviewing the preflight state.

help.summary: Move through the available benchmark runs without selecting another input.
help.usage: Press Up or Down to inspect another result and its terminal evidence.

help.summary: Add or remove the focused run from the current report comparison set.
help.usage: Press Space on a run; comparison becomes available only when exactly two compatible runs are selected.

help.summary: Move through actions displayed in the current contextual help overlay.
help.usage: Press Up or Down, or j or k, to read another legal action explanation.

help.summary: Close contextual help and restore the exact underlying focus and draft.
help.usage: Press Escape, question mark, h, or F1 to return without changing workspace state.
